ModMetaData.name: Vanity Case
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Makeup for colonists drawn with Facial Animation. Work in progress, not yet tested in game.
First feature: lipstick. Painted mouths such as the full lips of Vanilla Textures Expanded - Facial Animation have their red drawn into the texture, so the game cannot dye them. A lipstick is a piece of worn clothing with no picture on the colonist: while it is worn, the lips take its colour. This mod recolours the lips in memory, on your machine, from the textures you already have installed: no texture of another mod is copied or shipped. Four shades to start (caramel, rose, berry, forest); an apparel policy lets a colonist wear the shade that suits the occasion.
Interface in English.
If I go quiet
If I do not answer within a reasonable time after being contacted, anyone may freely update this or any other of my mods, including publishing a continuation of it. All credit must be preserved.
AI-generated
This mod's code is written with Claude Code (Anthropic) under human direction, review and testing. Stated openly: designing with these tools is my job.
Thanks
Nals for [NL] Facial Animation (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1635901197), whose mouths this mod recolours, and the Vanilla Expanded team for Vanilla Textures Expanded - [NL] Facial Animation (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2816938779), whose lips gave the idea. None of their files are copied here.
